environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with a Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No CloudFront distribution or API Gateway in front. No WAF attached. Any caller can POST comments with arbitrary HTML/JS payloads and retrieve the rendered HTML page. The Lambda execution role has DynamoDB read/write access to the comments table.
